scope: Eastserve (East Manchester) case boundary, inclusion/exclusion criteria, research questions

candidates.content: Case name: Eastserve community digital access and wireless broadband project, East Manchester
Core period 2000-2010; 2016-2017 exit observed as outcome, not core action chain
Core space: Beswick, Clayton, Openshaw; wider New East Manchester as diffusion/outcome
Include Eastserve1 pilot (450 homes, 10 community access points) in core process
Exclude city-wide digital strategy, IntelCities tool development, and other WuC pilots
Four research questions: combined intervention, wireless infrastructure, participation mechanisms, institutional transition

conflicts: Training count: ~2,500 course attendees in RR389 body vs 1,500 trained in RR389 summary
Household counts 450/4,500/9,000/2,200/3,500/1,500 refer to pilot, target, coverage, installed, reported, paying customers respectively
MEN archive pages carry a 2013-01-12 migration timestamp; Symera story content points to c.2009
Symera Eastserve Ltd dissolution in 2017 does not by itself establish the end date of Eastserve service
decisions_required: Time boundary: A 2000-2010 (recommended) / B 2000-2017 full lifecycle / C 2000-2006
Include Eastserve1 pilot in core process? (recommended yes)
Core space limited to Beswick, Clayton, Openshaw? (recommended yes)
Position of Symera 2009-2010, Cityserve 2016, dissolution 2017: core / outcome observation / exclude (recommended outcome observation)
Adopt the four draft research questions? Add digital inclusion and physical regeneration as a separate question?

history_impact.note: C12 and C07 (Carpenters Estate) are both WuC pilots; check C07 later during cross-case comparison.
